prompt:
You are White. Choose the strongest complete move from the legal list below to win this chess game. Consider the opponent reply. Every listed option is legal; observations cover only one opponent reply and do not prove safety.

Position
White pieces: rook a1, knight b1, bishop c1, queen d1, king e1, bishop f1, knight g1, rook h1, pawn a2, pawn b2, pawn c2, pawn d2, pawn e2, pawn f2, pawn g2, pawn h2
Black pieces: pawn a7, pawn b7, pawn c7, pawn d7, pawn e7, pawn f7, pawn g7, pawn h7, rook a8, knight b8, bishop c8, queen d8, king e8, bishop f8, knight g8, rook h8
In check: no
White pawns move toward rank 8; Black pawns toward rank 1.

Relevant skills
opening-white-centre: Start with a central pawn and a development plan
Trigger: You are White in the first three moves, both central pawns are still on d2/e2, both kings and queens are home, and you are not in check.
Action: Consider 1.e4 (e2e4) or 1.d4 (d2d4) to occupy the centre and free a bishop. One familiar start is 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3: the knight develops and attacks e5. After d4, develop toward the centre and consider c4 against ...d5. These are examples; choose from the current legal options and respond to the actual opponent move.
Counterexample: An early enemy attack or exposed piece can require a different move. Do not push a second central pawn automatically, and do not assume Black will play the example reply.
development: Develop toward the centre
Trigger: Early in the game and minor pieces remain on their starting squares.
Action: Prefer useful central pawn moves and development of knights and bishops. Coordinate pieces and prepare legal castling. Move the same piece repeatedly only for a concrete purpose.
Counterexample: A threatened piece or an immediate tactical opportunity can require another move. Do not mechanically develop while a queen can be won or your king is threatened.

knight b1: b1a3 (Na3), b1c3 (Nc3)
knight g1: g1f3 (Nf3), g1h3 (Nh3)
pawn a2: a2a3 (a3), a2a4 (a4)
pawn b2: b2b3 (b3), b2b4 (b4)
pawn c2: c2c3 (c3), c2c4 (c4)
pawn d2: d2d3 (d3), d2d4 (d4)
pawn e2: e2e3 (e3), e2e4 (e4)
pawn f2: f2f3 (f3), f2f4 (f4)
pawn g2: g2g3 (g3), g2g4 (g4)
pawn h2: h2h3 (h3), h2h4 (h4)

Final answer: return only {"move":"YOUR_CHOSEN_UCI"}. Replace YOUR_CHOSEN_UCI with one exact UCI string from Legal moves.
